description: This file implements access control management functions for channels within the Mattermost server, including policy retrieval, creation, deletion, expression checking, user testing, and permission validation.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing access control management functions for channels.

methods.name: GetChannelsForPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves channels associated with a specific access control policy, handling parent and channel policy types.

methods.name: GetAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Fetches an access control policy by ID.

methods.name: CreateOrUpdateAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates an access control policy.

methods.name: DeleteAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Deletes an access control policy by ID.

methods.name: CheckExpression
methods.description: Validates a CEL expression for correctness.

methods.name: TestExpression
methods.description: Tests a CEL expression against users and returns matching users.

methods.name: AssignAccessControlPolicyToChannels
methods.description: Assigns a parent policy to multiple channels, creating or inheriting policies as needed.

methods.name: UnassignPoliciesFromChannels
methods.description: Removes a policy assignment from specified channels.

methods.name: SearchAccessControlPolicies
methods.description: Searches for access control policies based on criteria.

methods.name: GetAccessControlPolicyAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes for a specific policy and channel action.

methods.name: GetAccessControlFieldsAutocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for access control property fields.

methods.name: UpdateAccessControlPoliciesActive
methods.description: Batch updates the active status of multiple policies.

methods.name: ExpressionToVisualAST
methods.description: Converts an expression into a visual AST representation.

methods.name: ValidateChannelAccessControlPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to manage access control for a specific channel.

methods.name: ValidateAccessControlPolicyPermission
methods.description: Validates if a user has permission to manage a specific policy.

methods.name: ValidateAccessControlPolicyPermissionWithOptions
methods.description: Validates policy permissions with additional options like read-only mode and channel context.

methods.name: ValidateChannelAccessControlPolicyCreation
methods.description: Validates if a user can create a channel-specific access control policy.

methods.name: TestExpressionWithChannelContext
methods.description: Tests expressions in the context of a channel admin, ensuring they only see matching users.

methods.name: ValidateExpressionAgainstRequester
methods.description: Validates an expression directly against a specific user ID.
